migration_steps: Update import statements in relevant files to point to the new package.
Verify that the new package is correctly installed and working as expected.
suggested_tests: Test the replacement package thoroughly to ensure it is working as expected.
Write unit tests to cover the usage of the replacement package.
gap_analysis: Potential incompatibility with existing code that is tightly coupled with the original package.
Potential for regressions if the new package does not provide the same level of functionality as the original package.
